Indian Journal for Training & Development (IJTD)

Home / IJTD Journal
Since 1971

The Official Peer-Reviewed Journal

The Indian Journal for Training and Development (IJTD) is the official quarterly peer-reviewed publication of the Indian Society for Training & Development (ISTD), New Delhi. It holds a respected place in Indian management literature, providing a forum for exchange of ideas and research insights among professionals, HR directors, consultants, and academicians.

IJTD publishes original empirical research, case studies, book reviews, and conceptual essays that advance the discipline of human resource development, pedagogical innovations, instructional design, and organizational culture.

  • Frequency: Quarterly (4 Issues per year)
  • Focus Areas: HRD, Training Evaluation, Microlearning, AI in Pedagogy, Leadership
  • Circulation: Distributed to over 13,500 members, corporate libraries & business schools
  • Review Process: Double-blind peer review by an eminent editorial panel
Submit Research Paper
Submissions

Author & Contributor Guidelines

Manuscript Submission Criteria

  • • Originality: Manuscripts must be original, unpublished, and not under consideration elsewhere.
  • • Length: Articles should generally be between 3,500 and 6,000 words including tables, charts, and references.
  • • Abstract: Every submission must include an abstract of 150-250 words and 4 to 6 keywords.
  • • Citation Style: APA 7th Edition style must be adhered to for in-text citations and reference list.
  • • Plagiarism Policy: Submissions are checked for similarity. Permissible similarity index is under 10%.

Where to Submit:

Send manuscripts directly to the Editorial Board via email at ijtd@istd.in with a copy to jaipuristd@gmail.com, including author biography and affiliation.
